question: A proton-neutron pair and a neutron-neutron pair are brought to nearly the same nuclear separation. What can be inferred about the nature of nuclear force from this comparison?

options.A: Nuclear force is strongly dependent on the electrical charges of nucleons.
options.B: Nuclear force acts only between a proton and a neutron, not between two neutrons.
options.C: Nuclear force is nearly charge independent: at the same nuclear separation, proton-neutron and neutron-neutron pairs experience nearly the same nuclear force.
options.D: Nuclear force is a purely electrostatic attraction.
